dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: While patrolling the area, I was sure I'd sensed a familiar presence, so I came over to take a look, and sure enough, here you are.

choices.text: Hello, Clorinde!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: If Miss Charlotte were to see you like this, I'm guessing she'd take a hundred pictures and write up a report...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: #"Sword-Wielding {NICKNAME}'s Secret Side Hustle: Exclusive Cocktails From Teyvat's Explorer Extraordinaire"...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: You'd make the front pages of every major newspaper, and there'd be crowds of Fontainian tourists flocking to your drinks stand, causing gridlock on the streets of Mondstadt.

choices.text: I think you're being a little bit dramatic...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Luckily for you, I turned down Miss Charlotte's request to accompany me here, so you're unlikely to be seeing any scenes like that. Let's quietly celebrate this moment of peace.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Hmm, and on that note, I'd like a Caramel Blaze...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: ...That look on your face tells me you have a lot of questions you want to ask.

choices.text: Let me mix you a cocktail first.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Calm and effortless... I'm shocked to learn you're a real pro at this sort of thing...

choices.text: You can drink while we chat.
If that really happened, I wouldn't be able to cope...
Please have a seat, honored customer!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, this new creation is called... "Leisuretime Lightning."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A cocktail made exclusively for Champion Duelists — enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Hmm? Mm... Have you added fruit wine? It tastes wonderful... This is ideal for me!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: There's a subtle saltiness that combines well with the tartness of the fruit and the sweetness of the caramel — each sip balances delicately on the edge of perfection.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: The color of the wine also fits well with the name, and the lightning imagery contrasts with the fiery nature of the Caramel Blaze...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: But where does the "leisuretime" part come in?

choices.text: Don't you find Mondstadt to be a leisurely place?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I see... That certainly matches the impression this cocktail gives me.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Its unique aroma and taste will hold a special place in my memories of Mondstadt.

choices.text: I'm glad you like it!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Do you think, if the chance were to present itself, you'd be interested in mixing drinks somewhere else — a cafe, for instance, or the Hotel Debord?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh? Why do you ask?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Mostly for Navia and Miss Furina's sake — though obviously, I'd be more than happy to try more of your masterpieces myself.

choices.text: Of course! I'd love to let everyone have a taste!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I understand, I won't try to strongarm you... In any case, I truly appreciate your hospitality.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Thanks to you, whether I'm facing the powerful Captain of the Reconnaissance Company or discussing strategy with the Knights of Favonius, I'll be in my best condition!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Thanks to you, whether I'm summarizing the key lessons from my exchange with Miss Eula or discussing strategy with the Knights of Favonius, I'll be in my best condition!

choices.text: It's hard to say right now, but who knows what the future holds?
Your satisfaction is my motivation!
Taking it easy is what traveling's all about!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your Caramel Blaze is ready. Try not to drink it all in one go...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: It sure lives up to its name. The color reminds me of a raging fire, while that aroma... really hits you head-on.

choices.text: Are you okay?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I'm alright, I just need a little time to get used to it.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: As I recall, the last time I drank alcohol was at a wine tasting event that Navia invited me to last year. I only had a small sip of Sassica Wine, and it was nowhere near as strong as this concoction of yours.

choices.text: So you basically don't drink at all?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: From a purely rational perspective, alcohol can cause dizziness and impair one's ability to work, so it's best avoided altogether.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: But when Miss Furina saw me off at the docks, she mentioned that Mondstadt is "the land of wine and poetry." Since I'm here, I thought I should at least try the local specialties...

choices.text: That's reasonable — it would be a shame not to.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: In fact, according to my intelligence, the Captain of the Reconnaissance Company, who I'm preparing to spar with... has quite the refined taste for fine wine.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Her publicly available battle reports are truly a sight to behold.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: In fact, Captain Eula, whom I sparred with earlier... has quite the refined taste for fine wine.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: She even gifted me a bottle of Romaritime Flower Fruit Extract, which is no longer produced in Fontaine and can now only be found overseas.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Out of the utmost respect for her skills, I feel compelled to deepen my knowledge of Mondstadt's wines.

choices.text: Let me think carefully before I mix you another drink!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I truly appreciate all the trouble you're going to.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you seen much of Mondstadt yet?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I've seen a little. I took a stroll around the city the first day I got here.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Navia's done some rather extensive research on this place. Many of the scenes and illustrations for the Tabletop Troupe were inspired by views of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: However, the way she describes the atmosphere in her worldbuilding is quite different from the real Mondstadt. The deepest impression I've got since arriving here is one of swords and shields.

choices.text: Swords and shields?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Hmm, perhaps because I've mostly just visited the blacksmith and the training grounds?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Recently, the newer weapons and armor produced in Mondstadt have been created using a completely different heat treatment process from those in Fontaine, with a higher carbon content in the surface layer.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: While this has slightly reduced their overall toughness, their impact resistance has greatly improved. These newer weapons give off a smell like overbrewed coffee...

choices.text: I... can't say I've noticed.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Mmm... Perhaps it's because that scent gave me such a positive first impression. You see, Fontaine's signature metalwork is often coated with a protective agent that contains Marcotte.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Over time, the faint fragrance becomes overly sweet... and for some reason, it makes my teeth feel funny. I don't imagine the scent of Mondstadt's swords and shields would cause the same level of irritation.

choices.text: Well, I've definitely learned something new today!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Of course, there is a solution to this problem.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: The next time you find yourself in Fontaine, there's another protective agent I can recommend — one that's as neutral as water, without any excess fragrance.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: If you also dislike being bombarded with sweetness, this protective agent should suit you well.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you usually drink?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Hmm... When I'm working, I often drink coffee, but with meals, I prefer a lighter-tasting drink, like Bulle Fruit juice.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Since I eat a lot of meat, the slight acidity of the juice helps balance out the greasiness. Over time, I've grown accustomed to the sour taste.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: After the swordsmanship exchange, the Knights of Favonius rather kindly treated me to some traditional Mondstadt cuisine.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I had eight different meat dishes, and all of them were excellent. The portions were huge, and only the highest-quality cuts were used. Everything was cooked to absolute perfection.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Of course, there was still room for improvement. When catering to tourists, the Sticky Honey Roast and "Pile 'Em Up" might benefit from a slightly lighter sauce.

choices.text: Sounds like they treated you to a feast!

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I've certainly tried all the red meat dishes. I think I've had enough calories to sustain three days of vigorous work, so I've had to decline all subsequent dining invitations.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: To be honest, I can still taste the grease. There must be a way to cleanse my palate...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that a gift from the knights?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Indeed it is. The knights codenamed "Hazelnut 3" and "Hazelnut 5" gave me this crest. I must say, it's exquisite.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: They told me the design has only just been finalized — apparently, it's only presented to important guests. They said they're making a badge for you, too, but it hasn't been finished yet...

choices.text: Hazelnut... Why have I never heard of these two...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: ...You're not wrong. I guess it's similar to how I can't remember the name of every clerk in the Palais Mermonia.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: But I'm certain you'll get to know them in time. They're clearly seasoned veterans. Even though they work desk jobs, they still turn up in full armor.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: After handling my affairs, they headed to the tavern for a gathering, saying they wanted to continue last night's "duel" and determine who had the highest alcohol tolerance.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Drinking barrels of beer the night before, yet being able to work with clear minds the next day... Whew.

choices.text: That's just how Mondstadt is.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: So, what you're saying is — while Mondstadters may seem carefree, they actually have an admirable ability to know their limits when it comes to drinking.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, by the way, Miss Emilie was here too...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Huh? Does that mean she's already finished her commission? She's certainly efficient...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Once I return to Fontaine, perhaps I can let Sigewinne know that I'd be happy to purchase her latest perfume.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh? It sounds like you know her quite well?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I'm not sure I'd say that...

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: On my way to Mondstadt, we happened to take the same boat. Naturally, we got to chatting.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: I've often heard Sigewinne praise her work. After conversing with her on the journey over, I must say... she is indeed a rare and refined individual.

choices.text: Refined?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: She's gentle and composed, yet keeps others at a distance... Perhaps it's due to her profession. I find this approach ideal — it allows one to maintain a lasting sense of inner peace...

choices.text: Sounds like... you want me to arrange a get-together?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Thank you, but there's really no need to set anything up. Our work rarely intersects, and our social circles hardly make for a Venn diagram, if you know what I mean.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Best to just let things take their natural course.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Emilie likes to drink tea. How about you?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Are you already planning the details of our hypothetical get-together?

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Based on my previous experiences with alcohol, I'd guess my tolerance is similar to Emilie's. Fruit liqueur is probably my limit.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: So when the time comes, I think you'd be best off mixing similar drinks for the both of us.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I've come up with a drink that'll be more to your liking. Please, wait a moment.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Alright, I'll make sure I'm mentally prepared.

response.speaker: Clorinde
response.text: Even if it's still a bit strong, I'll do my best to finish it...

choices.text: The next time I'm in Fontaine, why don't we all hang out together?
That's quite a "refined" way to put it...
Mondstadters like nothing more than to unwind with a drink after work!
The Knights of Favonius really is a big organization...
Have you tried all of Mondstadt's signature meat dishes?
I never realized there was so much complexity to how swords are made...
That's quite the comparison...
Why is that?
I need to tweak the recipe a little to make sure you're completely satisfied!
As long as you stay within your limits, I'm sure you'll be fine.
Don't force yourself to drink it if you don't want to.
Would you like some water?
